$comment: The role map for the lights. Every light colour has a shape and a word, so colour is never the only cue. The led field is the nominal drive value from the specification, tuned by eye on the real diffuser later. firmwareCurrent records what firmware/lib/practice/render.cpp holds today. A test fails when the firmware changes without this file, so the two cannot drift unseen. ledPercent is the brightness step the hub uses for the role (the upcoming light is 20 to 40 per cent, shown here as 30). The left hand is dimmer on the bar as a second signal and on screen as well.

roles.word: R and a finger number when known

roles.word: L and a finger number when known
